report_identity.report_title: Baguio Green Group Limited Annual Report 2023

business_overview.one_sentence: Baguio Green Group is a Hong Kong environmental services contractor focused on cleaning, waste management and recycling, landscaping, and pest management services.
business_overview.revenue_model: Service revenue is mainly recognised over time under cleaning, waste management/recycling, landscaping and pest management contracts; a small recycling goods component is recognised at a point in time.
business_notes: As at 31 December 2023, unexpired contracts on hand were disclosed at HK$4,430.8 million, with HK$2,238.0 million expected to be recognised by end-2024.
The group serves government, quasi-government and other customers; trade receivables reflect tender/payment terms and credit periods.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported profit is supported by operating cash flow in 2022-2023, but contract growth absorbed cash through a HK$147.4m increase in trade receivables in 2023 and capex has been volatile. A conservative profit haircut is required before treating profit as distributable owner cash.

gaps: Cash and cash equivalents are not split by listed parent, Hong Kong operating subsidiaries and PRC subsidiary; haircut uses group-level ordinary operating subsidiary default.

The annual report does not disclose an exact required operating cash balance; this analysis estimates HK$30m based on daily operation needs, working-capital volatility and payroll/service contract scale.
Only 2022 and 2023 operating cash-flow statements are in the 2023 annual report; 2021 cash-flow figures were cross-checked from the 2022 annual report saved in this run's work directory.
